title: GmaryLogin
description: A simple auth plugin to protect your Minecraft server with velocity support
body:
![Login](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dca1a6693224ac3329b9d9e0d84ec375a9c6f935.jpeg)
**Welcome to the GmaryLogin auth plugin!**

**Features:**

- Velocity routing for hub servers
- BossBar support
- Prefix changeable.
- Fully customizable.
- title support


_GmaryLogin is protect your server_


![GmaryLogin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a4602944f6f2374f1ec8db43653dca9642d045e.webp)

This plugin is made by: **Yusuf**
